status: Prepared; starting new SFT requires passing the source screen.

eligibility.per_teacher: At least 2 of 3 native successes with correct visible explanation and one reviewed trajectory.
eligibility.per_student: At least 2 of 3 with the same attributable failure. Record protocol-only errors separately from incorrect actions. Report source count by error category and group.
eligibility.source_units: An official TRAIN ID and its variants stay together. Report closely related source IDs in the same intent group. Do not count fixtures, seeds or wording variants as independent questions.

arms.B: Same answer with Qwen teacher trajectory
arms.C: Same answer with DeepSeek teacher trajectory
arms.D: Same answer plus a factually verified short decisive explanation
arms.E: Same answer plus a matched true task description that omits the decisive condition

training.loss: Mean next-token cross entropy within each segment, then mean over examples. Weights: answer 1.0, format including EOS 0.1, auxiliary text 0.5 when present, prompt and visible explanation 0. IDs for all nonauxiliary segments must be identical across arms for each source.
training.pairing: Share example order, initialization within seed, answer text, answer placements relative to JSON keys, batch composition and generation settings. Save active adapter hashes.

selection.metric: Source-macro paired behavior pass on DEV. Both original and reversed requirement must pass every discriminating fixture.
selection.tie_break: There is no new separate development-retention partition in this run. Use earliest checkpoint on tied DEV scores. Never use final retention for selection.
selection.heldout: Freeze the arms and selected checkpoint procedure before confirmation. Report paired wins/losses and source denominators across all seeds. Do not select a best seed on confirmation.
selection.gates: ABC: three seeds when data threshold met. D/E: begin with one matched seed; require all three before reporting a confirmatory mechanism comparison.

evaluation.task_inputs: Question and common tool help only.
